title: 诗人看月亮
en: The Poet Looks at the Moon

sents.zh: 唐朝有一位很有名的诗人，叫李白。
sents.en: The Tang dynasty had a very famous poet called Li Bai.
He loved looking at the moon.

sents.zh: 有一天晚上，他一个人坐在外面。
sents.en: One night he sat outside alone.
The moon in the sky was big and bright.
The ground was white and bright.
He thought of his home far away.
His heart felt a little sad.

sents.zh: 他写下了一首很有名的诗。
sents.en: He wrote a very famous poem.

sents.zh: 很多不在家的人读了这首诗。
sents.en: Many people away from home have read this poem.

sents.zh: 他们看月亮的时候，也会想起家。
sents.en: When they look at the moon, they think of home too.
